headline: Frontline Base Swaps Slacken as Northern Attrition Mounts
war_summary: Since the evening report, the tempo of base exchanges has noticeably decelerated across the map, with fresh territorial shifts confined to the flanks at Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf, where Breaker Town witnessed continued friction. The bitter fighting previously noted across Linn of Mercy and Fisherman’s Row has paused its rapid changing of hands over the last two hours, though regional garrisons remain locked in position. Even without widespread structural collapse, relentless attrition continues to bleed the central and northern sectors dry. Callahan’s Passage absorbed nearly three thousand casualties in the two-hour watch alone, while Weathered Expanse counted over twenty-five hundred fallen amid heavy artillery exchanges. Severe grinding also persists through Palantine Berm and Marban Hollow, where both sides trade losses along heavily fortified lines without shifting control. While the frontline perimeter holds firmer than in previous hours, massive casualties in the interior choke points signal that neither command has relented in its pressure.
